Oracle Fusion HCM: pages switching to Redwood

HCM pages that switch to Redwood by default, by release, with the other HCM end-of-support and removal notices Oracle has published. Where Oracle says so, you can still set the profile option back to No.

Oracle announces these HCM changes in its HCM What's New documents as Redwood default switches (and a few end-of-support, migration or removal notices), not as opt-in expirations. They are not on Oracle's Current Opt-In Expirations list and are not part of the former opt-ins counts on this site. Checked against each Oracle page on 2026-10-17.

Impact ratings are our editorial view of how much a change affects day-to-day users and testing. Always confirm details on the linked Oracle page.

Jump to: 26B (6) · 26C (5) · 26D (9) · 27A and later (7)

26B (6)

Redwood Extended Lookup Codes page by default

Global HRSwitches to Redwood by defaultFrom 26BRevert: Profile option can be set back to No

The Extended Lookup Codes page switches to Redwood by default from 26B; Oracle no longer fixes or enhances the classic page.

Pages affected: Extended Lookup Codes

Profile options named on Oracle's page: ORA_HRC_EXTENDED_LOOKUP_CODES_REDWOOD_ENABLED, ORA_HCM_VBCS_PWA_ENABLED

Oracle source

Redwood Document Type Security Profiles page by default

Global HRSwitches to Redwood by defaultFrom 26BRevert: Profile option can be set back to No

The Document Type Security Profiles page switches to Redwood by default from 26B; Oracle no longer fixes or enhances the classic page.

Pages affected: Document Type Security Profiles

Profile options named on Oracle's page: ORA_PER_DOCUMENT_TYPE_SECURITY_PROFILE_REDWOOD_ENABLED, ORA_HCM_VBCS_PWA_ENABLED

Oracle source

Four UK Payroll pages switch to Redwood by default in 26B.

Profile options named on Oracle's page: ORA_HRX_GB_COURT_ORDER_REDWOOD_ENABLED, ORA_HRX_GB_TAXABLE_BEN_REDWOOD_ENABLED, ORA_HRX_GB_PAE_REDWOOD_ENABLED, ORA_HRX_GB_STAT_DEDN_REDWOOD_ENABLED

Redwood Oracle Communicate by default

Employee ExperienceSwitches to Redwood by defaultFrom 26BRevert: None stated: Oracle deprecates the profile option

Oracle Communicate switches to Redwood by default from 26B, and its Redwood profile option is deprecated.

Pages affected: Oracle Communicate

Profile options named on Oracle's page: ORA_HCO_REDWOOD_ENABLED

Oracle source

Legacy Dynamic Skills no longer supported

Dynamic SkillsMigrationFrom 26BRevert: None stated

Skill sections that subscribe to Skills Center must move to Enhanced Dynamic Skills; Oracle stops supporting legacy Dynamic Skills from 26B.

Pages affected: Skill sections subscribed to Skills Center

Oracle's title: “IMPORTANT: Mandatory Migration to Enhanced Dynamic Skills”

Oracle source

Predictive-AI skill suggestions no longer supported

Dynamic SkillsMigrationFrom 26BRevert: None stated

Skill suggestions based on predictive AI are no longer supported from 26B; Oracle replaces them with generative-AI suggestions.

Pages affected: Skill suggestions in Skills Center, job and position profiles, role guides, requisitions, gigs and learning items

Oracle's title: “IMPORTANT: Mandatory Migration to Enhanced Skills Suggestions Using Generative AI”

Oracle source

26D (next update, already announced) (9)

Redwood person pages by default (moved from 26C)

Global HRSwitches to Redwood by defaultFrom 26DRevert: Profile option can be set back to No

Six person pages switch to Redwood by default in 26D; Oracle had planned this for 26C.

Pages affected: Personal Details, Contact Info, Identification Info, Family and Emergency Contacts, Additional Person Info, Person Identifiers for External Applications

Profile options named on Oracle's page: ORA_PER_PERSONAL_INFORMATION_REDWOOD_ENABLED, ORA_PER_ADDITIONAL_PERSONAL_INFO_REDWOOD_ENABLED, ORA_PER_PERSON_IDENTIFIERS_FOR_EXT_APP_REDWOOD_ENABLED
